acceptance: Two docs PRs that each add an index entry merge in either order with no conflict (red test first on the generator)
The index check fails when an entry file has no index line, and passes after the generator runs
evolve pr refresh regenerates signal-codes.md, .darwin-set and the index and commits nothing else
fix: TDD first (red test before code), 100% coverage on new and changed functions, zero comments, the package note and the spec updated.
routed_reason: changes skills/docs-write and adds a CI index check; console-owned per plan pr-merge-latency-2026-10
summary: Component P3 of plan pr-merge-latency-2026-10. Rebase churn on shared files gave 2-6 CI runs per PR and about 2000 CI-minutes over #979-#1005. (1) Replace the append-only docs/research-index.md with one file per entry and a generated index, with a generator and a check (CI fails a stale index). (2) A verb (for example evolve pr refresh) regenerates the generated files ((docs/architecture/signal-codes.md, go/.darwin-set, go/.cover-strict entries, the index)) on a rebase, so nobody merges them by hand. (3) The docs-write skill and the console runbook discourage stacked PRs, which squash merges turn into conflicts.
title: PR merge latency P3: remove the rebase hotspots (research index, generated files, stacked PRs)
